subject: Might Armor
text: Turning in the second set of Dragon Eggs at the Dragon Shrine rewards a Might Armor.

evidence.quote: Now, turn in your 2nd set of eggs, and take a Might Armor.

subject: Sheran Castle
text: A Dragon Egg from the third set is found inside a chest in the throne room of Sheran Castle.

evidence.quote: The first egg is in Sheran Castle, in the chest in the throne room.

subject: East Cave
text: The second Dragon Egg is located in the East Cave by Guy's House, east of Treck.

evidence.quote: The second egg is in the East Cave, by Guy's House, east of Treck.

subject: Old Cave
text: The third Dragon Egg is located on the 7th floor of the Old Cave.

evidence.quote: The third egg is down in the 7th floor of the Old Cave.

subject: Lyden
text: A Dragon Egg is found in the basement of the Wizard of Cookery in Lyden.

evidence.quote: The next Dragon Egg is a bit easier, in the Wizard of Cookery's basement in Lyden.

subject: Herat Cave
text: The fifth Dragon Egg is in the Herat Cave, in the chest on the first floor where the Stun Arrow was located.

evidence.quote: The fifth egg is in the Herat Cave, in the chest where the Stun Arrow was on the first floor.

subject: Arubus Cave
text: The sixth Dragon Egg is in Arubus Cave inside the portal on the second floor when the switch is in the up position.

evidence.quote: Arubus Cave houses the sixth egg. It's in the portal on the second floor (make sure the switch is in the 'up' position.)

subject: Glasadar Cave
text: The seventh Dragon Egg is in Glasadar Cave on the left side of the plateaus on the second floor.

evidence.quote: The seventh egg is in Glasadar Cave, on the left side of the plateaus on the second floor.

subject: Glasadar Tower
text: The eighth Dragon Egg is located in the hidden treasure room of Glasadar Tower, reached by traversing Glasadar Cave.

evidence.quote: But don't stop there, because what sucks is that you must journey through the Glasadar Cave to get the eighth egg, which lies in the hidden treasure room of Glasadar Tower.

subject: Might Shield
text: Returning the final set of Dragon Eggs to the Dragon yields a second Might Shield.

evidence.quote: Once you have all three of these, take them back to the Dragon to get your well-deserved second Might Shield.

subject: Warp Shrine
text: The warp attendant in the Warp Shrine heals the party for free and saves the game.

evidence.quote: The crazy warp guy heals you for free, as well as lets you save.

subject: Flame Plate
text: Flame Plates drop Might Armor.

evidence.quote: I had the Might Armor, which Flame Plates drop, Might Shields from the Dragon, and then Might Helmets that Bariuses drop.

subject: Barius
text: Bariuses drop Might Helmets.

evidence.quote: I had the Might Armor, which Flame Plates drop, Might Shields from the Dragon, and then Might Helmets that Bariuses drop.

subject: Fortress of Doom
text: A Power Potion is found in the basement circuit of the Fortress of Doom.

evidence.quote: Take the Power Potion, then make a circuit of the basement, coming back up on the right side.

subject: Fortress of Doom
text: A Power Potion is located in the right room on the second floor of the Fortress of Doom.

evidence.quote: Check the right room for a Power Potion.

subject: Fortress of Doom
text: A Spell Potion is located in the room on the other side of the second floor of the Fortress of Doom.

evidence.quote: Go around, take the Spell Potion in the room on the other side, and then ascend to the third floor.

subject: Fortress of Doom
text: Two Miracles are found at the back of the third floor of the Fortress of Doom.

evidence.quote: There are two Miracles at the back of the third floor.

subject: Fortress of Doom
text: Three Miracles are placed around the edges of the fourth floor in the Fortress of Doom.

evidence.quote: Head up to the fourth floor, where there are three Miracles placed around the edges.

subject: Gades
text: Gades casts Destroy for around 200-300 single-target damage, while Jerin should support with Boost, Champion, or Valor.

evidence.quote: He casts "Destroy", which does around 200-300 damage, but only to one character at a time, and since Jerin's spells are basically worthless in this battle, have her constantly cast Boost, Champion, or Valor.

subject: Gades
text: Gades casts Undead to heavily boost his attack power.

evidence.quote: Things start to get crazy when Gades uses "Undead", which strongly boosts his ATP.

subject: Amon
text: Amon casts Sunder for around 100 damage and Chaos to confuse the party, while Jerin's Vulcan spell deals effective damage.

evidence.quote: He casts Sunder, which is okay, dealing around 100 damage. . .but he still isn't a real big step up from Gades. Jerin's Vulcan spell does pretty good damage to Amos in this battle, so have her use that and heal time to time. Amos can muck you up a bit with Chaos, which can confuse all your characters, especially when Hero and Aguro start dueling.

subject: Daos
text: Daos attacks with Flood and Vulcan dealing around 100 HP damage, and inflicts paralysis with Amnesia.

evidence.quote: He throws stuff like Flood and Vulcan at you that deals around 100 HP damage. An annoyance he does is 'Amnesia', which constantly paralyzes your characters, and can sometimes put you in tough situations.

subject: Guard Daos
text: Guard Daos uses strong magic attacks and party-wide confusion, while Lufia rejoins the fight and deals heavy damage with Thunder.

evidence.quote: He can confuse all your characters in a round, and has the strongest magic attacks in the game. What's cool here, is that Lufia joins you for the final fiasco. Her Thunder attack can rock Daos's socks and then some.
